result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers put a visible search field on the home screen and handle typing and zero results well, with filter-caused, typo, truly-empty and offline cases. B goes further on memory: home branch as a changeable chip, filters kept across sessions, and Back keeping the query. It also spells out one-tap tasks such as Renew, Renew all, hours shown in the branch list and inline pickup changes, and gives each tab a clear reason. A puts Hours and Events in More and says less about what the app remembers. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers make search a visible field, give detailed behavior while typing, and handle zero results by cause, including filters, typos, a true miss, and offline errors. A does better at remembering state: it keeps the home branch across Search, Branches and Events, saves filters and sort between sessions, restores the query and scroll position on Back, and puts today's hours on the home screen and in each branch row. B adds useful extras such as debounce timing and a testing plan, but it moves Hours and Events into More and says less about what the app carries over.
